exceptions.scope: Exact reviewed Zod 3.25.76 resolution under Expo tooling (@expo/cli)
exceptions.reason: No patched Zod 3 exists, and latest Expo CLI 58.1.16 still requires ^3.25.76. The only vulnerable installed resolution is the exact reviewed Zod 3.25.76 under Expo CLI 58.1.15; application schemas use patched Zod 4.6.7. User approved a seven-day renewal on 2026-10-28 after reviewing the current tooling-only boundary.
exceptions.compensation: The exact CLI copy validates installed package devtools descriptors. The current project discovers only expo-sqlite with a webpage plugin, no executable CLI extensions, and neither Expo MCP tunnel package is installed. Backend/MCP runtime workspace filters exclude Expo CLI; static web/native app bundles do not execute its validators. Plugin-output validation would remain a memory-exhaustion risk if an executable plugin were introduced. See the 2026-10-28 review; new vulnerable resolutions or consumer versions fail closed.
